snippet.title: Emberville: Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Emberville is a pixel-art action-adventure-RPG most succinctly described as "Diablo meets Stardew Valley." Check out its brand-new trailer, which announces its October 27 Early Access release date. It features Doug Cockle (The Witcher series), Alex Jordan (Cyberpunk 2077), and Jane Perry (Returnal, Baldur's Gate 3) as voice actors. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2295170/Emberville/

#ign #gaming
